profileEvidence.summary: Tenacious in pursuit and accustomed to group work, the Podenco Paternino was selected for hunting performance in Huelva. It works in packs for larger quarry and also follows rabbits and hares. Its voice changes in intensity between tracking, seeing quarry and holding it at bay, giving hunters different clues about what is happening out of sight.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A tenacious Huelva hunting dog whose changing voice signals tracking, sighting quarry and holding it at bay.
